SELECT * FROM crm_customer_credit WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(planned_amount - COALESCE(received_amount, 0), 0)), 0) AS occupied, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN due_date < #{today} THEN GREATEST(planned_amount - COALESCE(received_amount, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue FROM crm_receivable WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
